name: Merissa Stilwell
summary: Merissa Stilwell is a young human townsperson residing in Goldshire within Elwynn Forest. Standing right by the lamppost outside the Lion's Pride Inn, she offers a cheerful greeting and a helping hand to newcomers arriving from Northshire.

sections.title: A Welcoming Face in Goldshire
sections.body: Positioned just outside the bustling Lion's Pride Inn, Merissa Stilwell greets fresh travelers making their way into town from Northshire Valley. For wandering novices, she offers simple hospitality and practical advice on resting up and getting oriented. Sharing a surname with notable craftsmen and homesteaders across the kingdom—such as the blacksmith Jordan Stilwell and the Westfall defender Daphne Stilwell—she remains a peaceful local face amidst the kingdom's rising tensions.

faq.answer: Merissa is a friendly human resident of Goldshire. She stands near the streetlamp outside the Lion's Pride Inn, offering advice and a warm welcome to travelers entering the hamlet.

faq.q: Where can I find Merissa Stilwell?
faq.answer: She is located in central Goldshire in Elwynn Forest, standing next to a lamppost directly outside the front entrance of the Lion's Pride Inn.

faq.q: Is Merissa related to the other Stilwells in the kingdom?
faq.answer: While she shares her surname with prominent figures like the smith Jordan Stilwell and Daphne Stilwell in Westfall, she lives quietly in Goldshire, welcoming travelers rather than fighting bandits or forging blades.

faq.q: Does Merissa Stilwell offer any quests?
faq.answer: Yes, she assists new arrivals through the brief introductory task 'Welcome!', directing them to visit the local tavern and speak with the innkeeper.

angles.text: For Alliance recruits leaving the sheltered cloister of Northshire, Merissa represents the warm hospitality of Elwynn before the harsh realities of the Defias threat set in.
